_comment: The general chat model (LOCAL_LLM_STACK.md section 11, item 2; experiments/chat_general/PLAN.md, 'Choosing the winner'), one RunPod L4, one GPU job at a time. evals1: chat_eval + qa_eval of the live model (chat_sftfinal_v3), ctrl_sft, moe_sft and big_sft (chat_fw_big). sft: pk_base_v1 (d768 L12, 16k Llama 3-scheme vocabulary) + lever 1's SFT set at T 512 as conversation rows (tools/lever1_conversations.py; 313,606 dialogues, 463,695 replies, sha256 b7a43fb5...) under train.sft_loss all, BF16 GEMMs + flash attention (gated 25 Oct 2026), 18,620 steps x 16 = one pass in expectation over the 297,926 training rows, lr 1e-4 (big_sft's), warmup 200, cosine to 0.1. evals2: the same evals with all five models (the run of record for the winner). parity: ember (aa50a61, CUDA and CPU) vs mtstudio chat on the CPU, greedy, 40 frozen prompts. Uploads: TAG.gguf / TAG.safetensors for live, ctrlsft, moesft, bigsft; the two 8k vocabularies; vocab_llama3_bpe.gguf; pk_base_v1.safetensors; lever1_conv_v1.jsonl.gz.
